title: Migrations 437-445 governance role assignment, definition lifecycle, and tactical content acceptance
checks: migrations 438–445 apply and replay transactionally after migration 437
runtime retains assignment reads and bounded proposal execution but loses direct table writes and ledger access

start, dispose, and cancel enforce signed location action grants, direct or same-location role ownership, completed-session follow-up, required reasons, exact idempotent replay, and append-only actor history
runtime and Directus roles cannot mutate tactical lifecycle rows or read/write the private action ledger; append-only history rejects edits
active bound operator creates an attributed location role nomination; exact retry returns the same proposed row without activation

circle/role definition transitions require exact signed location grants and independent human review, replay idempotently, block assignment conflicts, keep immutable actor history, and deny runtime/Directus direct status changes

circle and role creation always yields draft records; exact create/update grants, same-location parents, draft-only edits, idempotent retries, private append-only before/after history, and runtime/Directus direct-write denial are enforced

tactical session creation requires exact signed location scope and active person binding, accepts only draft-safe fields, validates active same-location circles/roles, replays exact request keys, records immutable actor/reason history, and denies runtime/Directus direct writes

tactical item creation and open-item/planned-session edits require signed exact grants, validate linked records in-location, replay only identical requests, preserve lifecycle/approval fields, and append private immutable before/after history
read-only readback pages only the signed operator's nominations, rejects missing or mismatched scope, and omits nominee identity and mandate
review queue reveals nominee, submitter, role, and mandate only to a separately granted reviewer; keyset paging is bounded, and proposers cannot decide their own proposal
independent approval and rejection atomically update lifecycle state, require exact action grants and reason, reject repeat decisions, and preserve exact idempotent retries
decision history is append-only and private to the bounded function owner; runtime and Directus cannot read or mutate it directly
signed tenant context, exact location grant, active party binding, and request-content identity are enforced
role location, nominee active state, and delegate mandate are validated before writing
runtime cannot bypass the bounded write function, activate/delete assignments, inspect the private request ledger, or rewrite request history
isolation: Only a temporary PostgreSQL 16 container was used; candidate and legacy databases were not accessed.
